draft.title: -고 싶다
draft.description_md: Used to say what you want to do. With a first-person subject (or a question to you) use -고 싶다; for someone else use -고 싶어 하다. It attaches to action verbs and it is very common in daily conversation, in questions about plans, and in the TOPIK I listening section.
draft.formation_md:
- verb stem + 고 싶다: 가다 → 가고 싶다, 먹다 → 먹고 싶다
- third person: 가고 싶어 하다

examples.translation: I want to go to Korea.
What do you want to eat?
